scope: Unsupervised proposition-free skill-conditioned continuous pretraining, then frozen representations and few-label shared queries. Local existing CALVIN scene and unchanged scripted PhysicalOracle; not completion of the original HULC guide.
input: Current dual-camera RGB DINO features and 15D robot proprioception. Fixed RGB hue components associate all three objects; this is an identity prior, not learned object discovery. No history, GT poses/depth/segmentation/contact, symbolic state, old semantic weights or their features.
representation: Common AB-only per-channel normalization and 32D DINO channel PCA; preserve 2x2 ROI and 4x4 scene grids in both cameras. All objects retained. Four continuous 64D tokens (three objects, scene). Generic: AB-only fixed linear PCA; AE: new reconstruction encoder; interaction: same new encoder with action-conditioned prediction.
model: Shared object MLP 268-128-64, scene MLP1039-256-64, shared contextual residual MLP192-128-64. Shared object transition uses own/scene/mean object token, skill type, target flag, posthold; scene transition uses scene/mean/target token. No hand-coded logical effects or preconditions.
action: Whole open/lift/place/close primitive, one-hot skill type plus target object parameter when declared, plus historical endpoint posthold96/0 contract. First old unbound-place calls stay unbound.
loss: Equal mean of object DINO, object RGB geometry, whole-scene DINO, robot error. Current reconstruction + successor reconstruction weighted coordinate-wise 1+4*min(abs(real_after-real_before),1) +0.25*stopgrad successor latent MSE +0.01 variance floor(.5). Every fourth update adds observed two/three-step chains at0.25 weight each. No task-relevance pruning.
stage1_selection: C root-macro changed-weighted fixed-observation prediction MSE only. AE representation selected on C reconstruction then frozen before its own transition training. Generic and AE receive same2000 transition updates as joint model; AE additionally2000 reconstruction updates.
stage2_selection: C72 fixed state queries, equal Holding BCE/In BCE/drawer CE root mean; fixed0.5 binary thresholds, drawer argmax. No predicted-state label calibration. Full C reporting uses210 known development states, not independent test.
action_controls: At evaluation, same latent plus deterministic shuffled full action (hold contract preserved), zero skill+target, and target permutation within skill family; compare normal executable calls separately from refused/failed. Copy-state baseline.
independent_D: After model and evaluation code frozen, collect18 new roots:12 real four-skill chains (three colours x four starts: closed/open alternation), six challenge fixture roots (three colours x two layouts), nine paired reset conditions/root. Each root owns every branch/window. Old D never new blind. Main72 planned skills reported split into chain48 and challenge24; failures/refusals kept. Root-level provenance screened against old declarations.
closed_loop: Predeclare seed0; six of the twelve new D chain roots (rep0/1 each colour), matched reset for all3arms. Model transitions supply all successors; shared query reads predicted latent. Enumerate eight parameterized skills, beam32 horizon4, goal min(In(target),Closed)>=0.8. Reobserve/replan each whole skill, max6 calls. No GT in search/stopping; physical evaluator scores afterwards. No-plan and false completion count.
error_policy: Retain every run. At most one evidence-based correction, no D tuning. No formal success threshold is reduced. This is a bounded comparison, not a claim of solving the full original guide.
